comment: Status/evidence overrides merged by scripts/extract_requirements.py. The requirements index is generated; record implementation/test evidence here. Controlled status vocabulary: planned, in-progress, captured, implemented, tested, deferred, superseded. 'captured' means Phase 0 behavioral evidence exists; it does not mean the Rust implementation exists.

implementation: Cargo.toml (single Rust workspace with one primary server executable and capability crates)
tests: scripts/check.sh (workspace-wide compile, lint, and test gate)
PRD-ARCH-001.note: The one-server/one-PostgreSQL modular-monolith and canonical media publication are implemented. The local rebuildable search index remains Phase 6 work, so the full requirement stays in progress.

implementation: Cargo.toml and crates/*/Cargo.toml (compile-time capability dependency graph)
crates/melodee-domain/Cargo.toml (domain boundary has no web, SQL, or filesystem dependency)
tests: scripts/check.sh (cargo clippy and cargo test across the complete workspace graph)
PRD-ARCH-002.note: Capability boundaries are Rust crates within one deployable server; no deployable microservice boundary has been introduced.

implementation: crates/melodee-persistence/migrations/ (durable ingestion state, leases, history, manifests, and provenance)
tests: crates/melodee-persistence/tests/ (migration, claiming, recovery, history, and manifest integration tests against PostgreSQL)
PRD-ARCH-003.note: PostgreSQL is authoritative for the implemented ingestion and audit state. Catalog, user, identity, policy, and search-outbox state arrive in later phases, so the full cross-product requirement remains in progress.

PRD-ARCH-004.note: The rebuildable-projection decision is accepted, but no Tantivy index or rebuild path is implemented yet. This remains Phase 6 work rather than being overstated as shipped.

implementation: crates/melodee-domain/src/artist.rs and release.rs (stable Melodee-owned semantic IDs)
crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (ReleaseId and ID/hash-derived canonical publication plan)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/source.rs (source-boundary discovery without semantic identity inference)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (canonical paths ignore observed Artist/Release display values)
PRD-ARCH-005.note: The canonical filesystem stores media bytes under immutable Release IDs and byte hashes. Artist/title/source values remain observations and cannot determine identity or relocation.

implementation: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock (brokerless modular-monolith dependency set)
compose.dev.yaml (PostgreSQL is the only required development service)
tests: scripts/check.sh (dependency policy and complete workspace gate)
PRD-ARCH-006.note: The implemented server requires no RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Kubernetes. Any later addition still requires measured evidence and an ADR.

implementation: compatibility/melodee-api-v1/contracts/ (OpenAPI snapshot, route manifest, client usage, unified inventory)
PRD-API-M1-001.note: Native v1 surface captured (Issue 5). OpenSubsonic and Jellyfin captures are Issues 6-7.

PRD-API-M1-004.note: Public-ID shapes and stability evidenced; migration-time preservation remains Phase 11 work.

implementation: compatibility/scenarios/native-*.json (method/path, params, casing, null-vs-omitted, status codes, envelopes, pagination, ordering, URLs, headers captured for the critical path)
PRD-API-M1-005.note: Critical path covered; full-surface coverage tracked by route-inventory.json parityStatus.

PRD-API-M1-006.note: Parity matrix exists; client-used-uncaptured routes are the later-phase backlog.

PRD-STREAM-002.note: Range/seek captured. Transcoding paths, concurrent playback, and disconnect handling remain (performance phase / Issue 9).

implementation: design/evidence/phase-0/native-client-route-inventory.md (Android/Android Auto route inventory and gate prerequisites)
PRD-STREAM-003.note: Release gate; cannot run until the Rust server exists. Client-side prerequisites inventoried.

implementation: compatibility/opensubsonic/golden/auth/ (token/salt, plain+enc password, JWT, apiKey, form POST, bypass)
compatibility/opensubsonic/golden/ (browse, lists, media, annotation, playlists, community)
PRD-API-OS-004.note: All current music-relevant groups have golden scenarios; conditional groups recorded with prerequisites.

PRD-API-OS-006.note: apiKeyAuthentication and transcodeOffset are advertised but non-functional at baseline — preserving the advertisement while not the false claim needs a product decision in Phase 8.

PRD-API-OS-007.note: Real third-party OpenSubsonic client smoke (PRD-STREAM-003 analog) deferred to Phase 8 client-verification work; server-side contract fully captured.

implementation: compatibility/jellyfin/golden/discovery/ (middleware allowlist, marker triggers, root probe, fallthrough)
compatibility/jellyfin/golden/auth/ (issuance, all 5 token transports, failures, logout revocation)
compatibility/jellyfin/golden/discovery/ (unsupported video/TV/books scope: plain 404, no simulation)
design/evidence/phase-0/jellyfin-capture.md section 9 (documented music-client smoke path covered server-side)
PRD-API-JF-006.note: Real Finamp/Feishin/Streamyfin client smoke remains a Phase 8 verification activity; server-side contract for the documented workflow is fully captured.

implementation: compatibility/media/baseline.json + cases/ (31 synthetic cases: formats, metadata, conversion, artwork, validation, classification, failures)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (versioned libmp3lame VBR q4 / 48 kHz conversion profile with strict output verification)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (complete-decode verification and byte retention for existing single-audio-stream MP3)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/normalize.rs (bounded concurrent worker with lease-derived heartbeat and cancellation)
tests: crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (real FLAC/OGG/WAV/M4A conversion, existing MP3 retention, source safety, output verification, determinism)
crates/melodee-persistence/tests/normalization.rs (atomic publish, timestamp semantics, stale/missing manifest rejection)
compatibility/media/baseline.json environment.seededSettings (legacy conversion profile preserved as evidence)
PRD-MEDIA-002.note: The legacy-seeded -b:a 384k argument is retained for profile fidelity, but official libmp3lame behavior confirms it is ignored when -q:a enables VBR; it is not a bitrate cap. Phase 3.2 produces verified temporary output, not Phase 3.3 canonical publication.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (FFmpeg and Chromaprint/fpcalc process boundaries under ADR-0108)
tests: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (success, nonzero, timeout, cancellation, output-bound process tests)
PRD-MEDIA-003.note: Codec implementation remains delegated to mature external FOSS tools; Rust coordinates bounded structured subprocesses.

PRD-INGEST-001.note: Per-Release retry with bounded exponential backoff operates on durable work items (no root rescans). Media-stage retries arrive with later phases.

implementation: crates/melodee-persistence/src/work_items.rs (claim with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, leases, recovery, renewal)
tests: crates/melodee-persistence/tests/claiming.rs (exclusive claim, 1000x32 parallel queue, poll race, lease blocking/expiry)
PRD-INGEST-002.note: PostgreSQL lease-based concurrency proven across processes/workers; no process-local locks.

implementation: crates/melodee-ingestion/src/reconcile.rs (periodic reconciliation drives source of truth)
PRD-INGEST-003.note: Scan-based periodic reconciliation is authoritative. Missed watcher notifications are covered by tests.

implementation: crates/melodee-ingestion/src/reconcile.rs (discovered->settling->ready transitions and ready marker shortcut)
PRD-INGEST-004.note: Settling evidence is persisted in PostgreSQL and drives durable readiness transitions.

implementation: crates/melodee-ingestion/src/config.rs (inbound roots canonicalized, write-paths never touched)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/source.rs (safe symlink and path traversal filtering)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/validate.rs and publication.rs (read-only work/source validation and retained source disposition)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (source snapshots unchanged across success, tamper, symlink, cancellation, and conflicts)
crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/normalization.rs (source unchanged across real pathology, crash recovery, fencing, and 200-Release publication)
PRD-INGEST-005.note: Inbound trees remain read-only throughout Phase 3. Canonical publication always records source disposition retained; move/delete requires a later, separate durable policy decision.

implementation: crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (immutable publication plan, manifest v3, canonical asset invariants)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/validate.rs (structural preflight before canonical target I/O)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/publication.rs (copy, streamed size/hash verify, fsync, sealed verification, no-replace rename, exact-final adoption)
crates/melodee-persistence/src/work_items.rs (authorization, immutable plan, idempotent journal, receipt, fenced completion)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/src/publication.rs (deterministic asset/manifest/tree fsync, final-rename, and post-rename parent-fsync fault injection with retry convergence)
crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (validation, path/symlink/tamper rejection, resumable incoming, no-clobber final, cancellation, source retention)
crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/normalization.rs (rename-before-database-completion adoption, concurrent fencing, real pathology, and 200-Release Published scenario)
crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/normalization.rs (feature-gated deterministic lease theft during copy: stale cancellation, no final/receipt, direct retry convergence, source retention)
PRD-INGEST-006.note: Phase 3 publication is safe to retry and exposes only an absent or complete canonical Release. Source removal is intentionally not part of this non-destructive authorization.

implementation: compatibility/benchmarks/ (datasets, results with environment metadata, SUMMARY.md)
PRD-PERF-001.note: Legacy reference benchmarks exist and are repeatable. Rust-side benchmark suites continue in Phases 2-8.

implementation: compatibility/benchmarks/results/ (wall-clock cold/warm, response sizes, server memory at Tier C)
PRD-PERF-003.note: Wall-clock and memory captured. DB query counts and queue age require instrumentation deferred to the Rust performance suite (recorded as gap in scale-baseline.md).

implementation: design/evidence/phase-0/scale-baseline.md section 4 (per-Release pipeline cost shape ~3s; non-transactional restart behavior evidence)
PRD-PERF-004.note: The 200-Release crash/restart benchmark targets the Rust pipeline; legacy per-Release cost shape and durability hazards are baselined.

implementation: design/evidence/phase-0/scale-baseline.md sections 3, 5 (bottlenecks + proposed budgets labeled requirement-vs-proposal)

PRD-TEST-001.note: Golden fixture infrastructure exists for all three API surfaces + media. Rust-side differential suites activate in Phases 2-8.

implementation: compatibility/melodee-api-v1/golden/ + opensubsonic/golden/ + jellyfin/golden/ (normalized golden request/response fixtures incl. negative paths)
compatibility/media/ (31-case synthetic corpus incl. malformed tags, corrupt/truncated audio, invalid artwork, duplicate track numbers)

PRD-TEST-006.note: Crash/retry/idempotency fault-injection harness targets the Rust pipeline; legacy fault behavior baselined.

implementation: compatibility/benchmarks/ (3 tiers, environment metadata, machine-readable results)
crates/melodee-persistence/ (durable work queue foundation: items, leases, retries, history)
PRD-WORK-001.note: Durable work queue core delivered. Scheduled triggers/maintenance tasks (PRD-WORK-003) arrive with later phases.

tests: apps/melodee-cli (manual command verification in docs and local ops)
PRD-WORK-004.note: CLI triggers are implemented and operate on the same durable queue as server reconciliation.

PRD-WORK-005.note: Retry/reprocess with durable history implemented; pause/resume of pools arrives with worker pools.

PRD-OBS-001.note: Structured tracing across work execution; API/provider correlation propagation arrives with those surfaces.

implementation: apps/melodee-cli/src/main.rs (work show prints state, attempts, last error, event history)
apps/melodee-server/src/admin.rs (Admin diagnostics API: state counts, bounded listing, work-item detail, event history, active leases)
apps/melodee-server/src/main.rs (admin diagnostics and PostgreSQL readiness routes wired into the server router)
apps/melodee-cli/src/main.rs (ingest status/manifest/publication diagnostics expose durable authorization, plan, receipt, and journal evidence)
tests: apps/melodee-server/tests/system_api.rs (bounded positive and fail-closed PostgreSQL readiness)
crates/melodee-persistence/tests/publication.rs (durable publication evidence and operator-safe problem state)
PRD-INGEST-010.note: State/worker/attempts/last error/timestamps/history and Phase 3 decision/publication evidence are durable and visible through the CLI and Rust-native Admin API. The requirement permits Admin UI/API; the graphical UI is a later phase.

PRD-WORK-003.note: Periodic reconciliation is implemented as the scheduled maintenance task required by this phase. Additional scheduled tasks remain deferred.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/lib.rs (Lofty native observation plus ffprobe technical fallback)
PRD-MEDIA-004.note: Observed tags are preserved; canonical identity resolution is not part of media inspection.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (extract and normalize embedded and external artwork via FFmpeg to JPEG, bounded by max_artwork_bytes, max dimension 1600px)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (strict non-empty JPEG/hash/dimension verification and bounded source preflight)
tests: crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (embedded/external JPEG and PNG, malformed/absurd artwork, multiple entries)
PRD-MEDIA-005.note: Phase 3.2 extraction, validation, and 1600x1600 JPEG normalization are tested. Replacement, upload, thumbnail serving, and the rest of the full PRD-MEDIA-005 surface remain later work, so the overall requirement is not complete.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (CUE FILE/TRACK/INDEX, M3U EXTINF, SFV paths, NFO type, LRC multi-timestamp semantics with structured findings)
tests: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (sidecar semantic and malformed-input unit tests)
crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (five-type real-file sidecar matrix and two-run determinism)
PRD-MEDIA-006.note: Phase 3.2 semantic observations are tested. Legacy CUE-driven track splitting and a broader parity corpus remain unimplemented, so the full sidecar requirement is not marked tested.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/lib.rs (streaming BLAKE3 byte hashes in ReleaseManifest)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (run_fpcalc: acoustic fingerprint via fpcalc -json, source audio file fingerprinting)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (FingerprintObservation: source-relative path, Chromaprint fingerprint, duration_ms)
crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (byte hash is an observation, not identity resolution)
tests: crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (deterministic BLAKE3 output hashes and source Chromaprint observations)
PRD-FP-002.note: Byte identity and acoustic evidence are represented separately. Alternate-version and uncertain-similarity decisions belong to the later catalog identity model.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (run_fpcalc: fpcalc -json -length for Chromaprint fingerprint + duration)
tests: crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (real fpcalc across FLAC/OGG/WAV/M4A/MP3 and deterministic fingerprints)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (fpcalc success, malformed/failure, timeout, cancellation, Unicode and leading-dash paths)
PRD-FP-003.note: fpcalc is the preferred initial fingerprint tool (ADR-0108). Fingerprints are computed from source audio, not normalized output.

PRD-FP-004.note: FingerprintObservation is evidence, not the required catalog identity abstraction. The final ubiquitous-language name and schema still require the PRD-mandated ADR before catalog schema freeze.

PRD-FP-005.note: Physical deduplication remains optional, but the future catalog/storage schema that must not preclude shared MediaAssets has not been designed yet.

implementation: crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (schema-versioned ReleaseManifest and semantic hash input)
crates/melodee-persistence/src/work_items.rs (transactional v1/v2/v3 manifest and immutable publication-plan persistence)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/validate.rs and publication.rs (complete canonical asset mapping and explicit v3 upgrade)
tests: crates/melodee-domain/tests/manifest_versions.rs (v1/v2 compatibility, deterministic layout, v2-to-v3 upgrade, semantic-hash stability)
PRD-INGEST-007.note: Manifest v3 satisfies the Phase 3 handoff without audio reread by adding stable Release identity, structural validation, authorization, retained disposition, and canonical mappings. The broad requirement remains in progress until the Phase 4 catalog consumer proves end-to-end insertion completeness.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/lib.rs (structured findings and tag-independent ffprobe validation)
crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (NormalizationReport.findings aggregate findings across audio, artwork, and sidecars)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/validate.rs (structural validation independent of identity/enrichment; uncertainty routes to NeedsReview)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/normalization.rs (fingerprint failure is retryable and does not classify playable media as structurally invalid)
crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (structurally complete local observations pass; missing presentation facts need review)

implementation: crates/melodee-ingestion/src/config.rs (explicit inspection concurrency and ffprobe timeout)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/config.rs (normalization concurrency, ffmpeg/fpcalc timeouts, work-area base)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/inspect.rs (bounded claim batch and spawn_blocking boundary)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/normalize.rs (bounded normalization concurrency with lease heartbeat)
crates/melodee-ingestion/src/publication_worker.rs (independently bounded validation/publication JoinSet workers with lease heartbeat and cancellation)
crates/melodee-media/src/lib.rs (streaming hashes and bounded tool output/artwork limits)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/normalization.rs (measured normalization concurrency reaches 8 and never exceeds 8; validation/publication claim pools configured independently to 8; 200 Releases reach Published)
PRD-INGEST-009.note: Inspection, normalization, validation, and publication are separately bounded, and normalization bounds child processes. The full requirement also calls for separate image, hashing/fingerprinting, conversion, external-enrichment, catalog-write, and search-index resource classes; those later-stage pools do not all exist.

implementation: crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (immutable ReleaseId and canonical layout invariants)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (canonical publication from Unicode/display-derived source observations uses lowercase ID/hash path)
PRD-STORAGE-001.note: Canonical media paths contain only immutable Release identity and byte hashes. Artist identity correction cannot determine or require a canonical media move.

implementation: crates/melodee-domain/src/manifest.rs (canonical layout v1 and stable shard derivation)
tests: crates/melodee-ingestion/tests/publication.rs (complete manifest/media/artwork layout, adoption, and conflict protection)
PRD-STORAGE-002.note: ADR-0116 accepted and Phase 3 implemented the exact immutable-ID-centric layout required before storage implementation.

implementation: crates/melodee-media/src/normalize.rs (valid existing MP3 bytes retained without re-encoding during ingestion)
tests: crates/melodee-media/tests/normalization_real.rs (valid existing VBR/CBR MP3 bytes retained exactly)
PRD-STORAGE-004.note: New ingestion avoids unnecessary re-encoding of valid MP3. Phase 11 registration of an existing canonical library without forced relocation or re-encoding is not implemented, so the broad migration requirement remains in progress.
